sections.html:
Geography

  • Studying geography helps us to understand:
    • the effects of different processes on the {{Q31}} of the Earth
    • the dynamic between {{Q32}} and population
  • Two main branches of study:
    • physical features
    • human lifestyles and their {{Q33}}
  • Specific study areas include biophysical, topographic, political, social, economic, historical and {{Q34}} geography, and also cartography.
  • Key point: geography helps us understand our surroundings and the associated {{Q35}}.
  • What geographers do:
    • find data, e.g. conduct censuses and collect information in the form of {{Q36}} using computer and satellite technology
    • analyse data - identify {{Q37}}, e.g. cause and effect
    • publish findings as maps, but a two-dimensional map will always have some {{Q38}}
    • aerial photos can show vegetation problems, {{Q39}} density, ocean floor etc.
    • Landsat pictures are used for monitoring {{Q40}} conditions.
